title: Book of Revelation KJV | Soft-Spoken Voice | Dark Screen Bible to Fall Asleep | Crashing Waves
description:
The Book of Revelation from the King James Version, read slowly and softly for sleep.

All 22 chapters, start to finish. No verse numbers, no music swells, no volume spikes. Peaceful crashing waves roll low underneath the whole way through. The screen goes dark after the first minute so it won't light up your room, and the reading fades out gently at the end instead of stopping cold.

Made for anyone who wants the Word playing while they rest: night owls, early risers, shift workers sleeping through the day, and anyone whose mind won't settle.

Tip: turn off Autoplay (the switch at the bottom of the player) so nothing else starts when the reading ends. You can also leave it playing on a loop while you are away, so the house is filled with the Word.

Scripture: King James Version (public domain).
Narration: AI-generated voice, produced and mastered by our team.
